observations: Photo 0 shows a complete-looking Toyota-style engine bay assembly on the ground with hoses/wiring attached; no clear engine code visible.
Photo 1 shows the engine from another angle with intake/throttle area and wiring harnesses; again no readable model/engine code.
Photo 2 shows the top cover/engine bay cover and surrounding components; no readable VIN/engine number/label.

identity.kind: complete engine assembly (petrol) with attached components

claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators for toyota venza,camry, sienna, Hylander,...
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine assembly with hoses/wiring, but do not clearly show an A/C compressor or confirm it matches those specific Toyota models.
No paperwork, shipping label, or markings visible in the photos to confirm origin.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos cannot confirm running/test results, internal knock, mileage, or whether the engine has been opened.

risks.risk: Engine may not be the correct variant/engine code for the buyer’s Toyota (Venza/Camry/Sienna/Highlander), leading to fitment/wiring/ECU mismatch.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate and/or stamped engine number (and the transmission code if included), plus a photo showing the exact A/C compressor part number if claimed included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: wrong/uncertain fitment and not proven working (treated like not guaranteed to start/run).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” is not verifiable from photos; engine could have internal damage or fail after installation.
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine running (cold start if possible) with sound showing no knocking, plus a short clip of stable idle and rev response.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not proven working.

risks.risk: “Complete engine with compressor” may be incomplete (missing A/C compressor, brackets, hoses, or required sensors).
risks.proof: Photo of the A/C compressor unit clearly attached/packaged with visible label/part number, and a checklist photo showing all included parts (compressor, alternator, starter, sensors, wiring harness connectors).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: compressor/operators not guaranteed included.

risks.risk: Mileage/“never opened” cannot be confirmed; could be rebuilt or opened previously.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of fasteners/seals and any tamper marks, plus a compression test / leak-down test sheet if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: mileage unknown and opening history unknown.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/engine number (stamped) and any ID label (and transmission code if included).
Video of the engine running (cold start preferred) showing no knocking and stable idle.
Photo proving the A/C compressor is included (clearly visible compressor + part number/label).
Photos showing all “operators/operators” included (a laid-out parts checklist) and confirmation of connectors/sensors count.
response.reason: The photos show an engine assembly, but the key details needed to price confidently (exact engine variant/compatibility, confirmed included compressor, and verified running/test status) are not readable or provable from the images.
